title.zh: 认可安老院委任证书的撤销
title.en: Cancellation of Approved Home Certificate of Appointment

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Children and Young Persons Act
(Chapter 38)
Cancellation of Approved Home Certificate of Appointment
It is hereby notified for general information that the Gazette Notification No. S 278/2008 of 30th May 2008 relating to Approved Home Certificate of Appointment is cancelled with effect from 1st January 2010.
